note: Canonical Birdy inventory. Single source of truth for the offline Python pipeline (corpus rendering, galaxy) and the browser syrinx engine. Contours are [timeFraction, Hz]. Functions marked confidence=experimental are backed by playback experiments; documented = described in the literature; inferred = plausible but not experimentally established.  Extended with syllable types fitted to field recordings: their ids start with `L`, they carry the cosine between their resynthesis and the audio they came from, and none of them has a documented function.

species.summary: Strongest evidence for word-order rules in birds: ABC = scan for danger, D = approach, ABC-D is a compound with a distinct behavioural response; the reversed order D-ABC elicits nothing.

syllables.label: A note
syllables.function: component of the ABC alarm cluster (snake/predator vigilance)

syllables.label: B note
syllables.function: component of the ABC alarm cluster

syllables.label: C note
syllables.function: component of the ABC alarm cluster

songs.label: ABC
songs.function: receivers scan horizontally for a predator

songs.label: ABC-D
songs.gloss: scan for danger, then come here
songs.function: compound message; elicits both responses, more than the sum of its parts

songs.label: D-ABC (reversed)
songs.function: artificially reversed order; in playback experiments it elicits neither response
